title: Microsoft Teams: End of support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17
summary: Microsoft Teams will end support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17 starting mid-December 2026, requiring iOS/iPadOS 18 or later for new releases. Existing versions will keep working without support. Organizations should notify users, encourage OS upgrades, update policies, and revise support documentation accordingly.
body:
[What and Why:]

Microsoft Teams is ending support for upcoming builds on iOS 17 and iPadOS 17. As this change rolls out, new Teams releases will require iOS 18 or later on iPhone and iPadOS 18 or later on iPad.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-December 2026 and expect to complete by early January 2027.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Users whose devices remain on iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 will not be able to install newer Teams releases that require a newer operating system.

Teams versions already installed on these devices will continue functioning without official support. This change does not introduce a block on opening or signing in to those existing installations.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

- Identify devices running iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 and notify affected users.- Advise users to upgrade to a supported operating system, then update Teams through the Apple App Store, to continue receiving supported Teams releases.- Review any mobile device management (MDM) or app deployment policies that pin or require specific iOS/iPadOS versions, and update them to allow iOS 18/iPadOS 18 so affected devices are not blocked from upgrading.- Update internal support documentation and helpdesk guidance.Learn more: Hardware requirements for Microsoft Teams.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
